text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition parties that boycotted general elections last November are scheduled to hold a meeting on Thursday to chart a new political course.
- Agriculture Minister Edith Nawakwi has urged donors to help government establish a fund to boost food production.
- Workers at four companies owned by Lonrho Plc went on strike on Wednesday demanding the removal of their general manager.
- Police used teargas to disperse opposition demonstrators in the northern mining town of Ndola.
- The larger grain borer, the grain attacking pest, has been sighted in Lusaka.
